To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the fatigue induced by a single 30-minute bout of running on a treadmill (1) increased the knee flexion angle at the end of the stance phase, (2) decreased knee flexion during the stance phase, and (3) did not change knee flexion angle during the swing phase.
2 weeks of knee extensor and knee flexor fatigue protocols resulted in a decrease in knee and hip sagittal plane range of motion (ROM), and an increase in knee and hip transverse plane ROM.
